alabandos: alabar + se — boasting (of themselves) (gerund alabando + enclitic se, -se reduced to -s as in tornós; Alabandos ivan 'they went about boasting'; ir + gerund; = alabándose)
alabándos: alabar + se — boasting (gerund + enclitic se reduced to -s; Alabándos se[d]ían 'they were boasting'; = alabándose)
sedían: seer — they were (imperfect 3rd pl., -ía ending, Pidal's restoration se[d]ían; seer + gerund, 'were (busy) doing': Alabándos sedían 'they were boasting'; = estaban, eran)
diré: dezir — I shall tell (future 1st sg., contracted dir-é; yo vos diré 'I shall tell you'; = diré)
mandáronle: mandar + le — they ordered him (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic dative le; mandáronle ir adelante 'they ordered him to go on ahead'; = le mandaron)
doliól: doler + le — it pained him (preterite 3rd sg. dolió + enclitic le reduced to -l; doliól el coraçón 'his heart ached'; = le dolió)
espesso: espesso — thick, dense (adj. masc. sg., ss spelling; un monte espesso 'a thick wood'; = espeso)
primas: prima — cousin (fem. pl.; sus primas 'his cousins'; = primas)
víolos: ver + los — he saw them (preterite 3rd sg. vío + enclitic los; Víolos venir 'he saw them coming'; = los vio)
vidien: ver — they saw, were seeing (imperfect 3rd pl., -ié ending, Pidal's vi[di]en; ellos nol vidien 'they did not see him'; = veían)
sabien: saber — they knew (imperfect 3rd pl., -ié ending; ni dend sabien ración 'nor knew anything of it'; = sabían)
ración: ración — portion, share; ni dend sabien ración 'nor knew a thing of it' (fem.; sense inferred from context, perhaps a spelling of razón 'account, word'; uncertain; modern ración 'portion')
vidiessen: ver — they might see (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., Pidal's vi[d]iessen; si ellos le vidiessen 'if they were to see him'; = viesen)
escapara: escapar — he would have escaped (3rd sg. -ra form, here with pluperfect-indicative / conditional sense, apodosis after si ... vidiessen; non escapara de muort 'he would not have escaped death'; = habría escapado)
amorteçidas: amorteçer — in a faint, swooned (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with primas; amorteçidas amas a dos 'both in a faint'; = amortecidas, desmayadas)
descavalgó: descavalgar — he dismounted (preterite 3rd sg.; luego descavalgó 'at once he got down'; = descabalgó)
arrendó: arrendar — he tied up by the rein, tethered (preterite 3rd sg.; arrendó el cavallo 'he tied up the horse'; = ató por las riendas; sense from context)
ensayaron: ensayar + se — they made a venture, tried themselves (preterite 3rd pl. with reflexive se; mal se ensayaron 'ill did they venture'; sense approximate, Pidal gives no note I rely on; = se ensayaron)
valas: ir + las — he goes (...) them (present 3rd sg. va + enclitic object las; ir + gerund; Valas tornando 'he went on turning them (round, to them)'; = las va)
traspuestas: traspuesto — overcome, in a swoon (past part. fem. pl. of traspõner, used as adjective; tanto son de traspuestas 'so far gone are they'; sense from context; = traspuestas)
puoden: poder — they can (present 3rd pl., Pidal's pu[o]den with the diphthong; nada dezir non puoden 'they cannot say anything'; = pueden)
partiéronsele: partir + se + le — were broken (for him) (preterite 3rd pl. + reflexive/passive se + dative le; Partiéronsele las telas 'the membranes of his heart were rent'; = se le partieron)
despertedes: despertar — wake up! (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending, used as exhortation; Despertedes, primas 'wake, cousins'; = despertéis, here despertad)
coman: comer — let them eat, lest they eat (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; non nos coman 'let them not eat us'; = coman)
recordando: recordar — waking up, coming to (gerund; Van recordando 'they are coming to'; = despertando, recobrando el sentido)
esforçadvos: esforçar + vos — take heart (imperative 2nd pl. + enclitic vos, -d- kept; Esforçadvos, primas 'take heart, cousins'; = esforzaos)
fallaren: fallar — they find (future subjunctive 3rd pl.; de que non me fallaren 'when they do not find me'; = hallaren)
morremos: morir — we shall die (future 1st pl., syncopated stem morr-; aquí morremos nos 'here we shall die'; = moriremos)
dandos: dar + nos — give us (imperative 2nd pl. dad + nos, with metathesis dadnos > dandos; dandos del agua 'give us some water'; = dadnos)
sombrero: sombrero — hat (masc.; un sombrero 'a hat'; = sombrero)
nuevo: nuevo — new (masc. sg.; nuevo era e fresco 'it was new and fresh'; = nuevo)
fresco: fresco — fresh, clean (masc. sg.; nuevo era e fresco 'new it was, and fresh'; = fresco)
valençial: Valençia + l(o) — Valençia + elided lo (object 'it', the hat); que de Valençial sacó 'which he had brought out of Valencia' (preterite sacó, pluperfect sense; = de Valencia lo sacó)
cogió: coger — he scooped up, gathered (preterite 3rd sg.; cogió del agua 'he took up some water'; = cogió)
lazradas: lazrar — suffering, worn out (past part. fem. pl. used as adjective; mucho son lazradas 'they are greatly worn out'; cf. lacerado; = lacradas, here agotadas)
fartó: fartar — he satisfied, gave their fill (preterite 3rd sg.; amas las fartó 'he gave them both their fill'; = las hartó)
rogó: rogar — he begged (preterite 3rd sg.; tanto las rogó 'so much he begged them'; = rogó)
assentó: assentar — he seated (preterite 3rd sg.; fata que las assentó 'until he had seated them'; = asentó, sentó)
conortando: conortar — comforting, cheering (gerund; Valas conortando 'he went comforting them'; = confortando, consolando)
metiendo: meter — putting in, instilling (gerund; metiendo coraçón 'putting heart into them'; = infundiendo)
esfuerçan: esforçar — they take heart, revive (present 3rd pl.; fata que esfuerçan 'until they take heart'; = se esfuerzan, cobran ánimo)
cubrió: cobrir — he covered (preterite 3rd sg., -ió; a amas las cubrió 'he covered both'; = cubrió)
partió: partir — he led away, took off (preterite 3rd sg., Pidal's parti[ó]; dent las partió 'he took them away from there'; = las apartó, se las llevó)
señeros: señero — alone, unaccompanied (masc. pl.; todos tres señeros 'all three alone'; = señeros, solos)
robredos: robredo — oak wood (masc. pl.; los robredos de Corpes 'the oak woods of Corpes'; = robledos)
arribados: arribar — arrived (past part. masc. pl., with son as auxiliary of an intransitive; ellos arribados son 'they have arrived'; = arribados, llegados)
urraca: Urraca — a woman's name, owner or founder of the tower at San Esteban (la torre de don Urraca 'the tower of Lady Urraca'; don here is the title before a woman's name, as with don Elvira); otherwise unidentified here
díag: Díag — Diego (Pidal's Dí[a]g Téllez, with the restored a; = Diego)
téllez: Téllez — patronymic 'son of Tello' (Díag Téllez, a vassal of Álvar Fáñez; = Téllez)
hiva: ir — he was going (imperfect 3rd sg., h- spelling; hiva reçebir 'he went to receive'; = iba)
mesurados: mesurado — courteous, restrained, well-mannered (past part. as adj., masc. pl.; siempre mesurados son 'ever courteous are they'; = mesurados)
pesóles: pesar + les — it grieved them (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic dative les; pesóles de coraçón 'it grieved them at heart'; = les pesó)
enffurçión: enfurçión — tribute in kind, provisions due to a lord or guest (Pidal's term; a las fijas del Çid danles enffurçión 'they give the Cid's daughters provisions'; grant enffurçión 'great gifts of provisions'; sense per Pidal, no modern word)
sovieron: seer — they stayed (strong preterite 3rd pl. of seer 'to be, stay'; allí sovieron ellas 'there they stayed'; = estuvieron)
sabidas: saber — known (past part. fem. pl., passive with son; estas nuevas sabidas son 'these tidings are known'; = sabidas)
dada: dar — given (past part. fem. sg., agreeing with ondra; tal ondra me an dada 'such honour they have given me'; = dada)
par: por — by (par for por in an oath; par aquesta barba 'by this beard'; = por)
messó: messar — he plucked, tore at (preterite 3rd sg.; barba que nadi non messó 'beard that no one has plucked'; = mesó)
lograrán: lograr — they will enjoy, profit from (future 3rd pl.; non la lograrán 'they shall not enjoy it'; sense from context, uncertain; la refers to the outrage/matter; modern lograr 'achieve')
casaré: casar — I shall marry off (future 1st sg.; bien las casaré yo 'I shall marry them well'; = casaré)
quales: qual — whom, such as (relative pronoun, masc. pl.; dozientos cavalleros, quales mio Çid mandó 'two hundred knights, such as the Cid ordered'; = cuales)
dixoles: dezir — he told them (strong preterite 3rd sg. dixo + enclitic les; dixoles fuertemientre 'he told them strongly'; = les dijo)
andidiessen: andar — they should travel (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., in indirect command; que andidiessen de dia e de noch 'that they should travel day and night'; = anduviesen)
aduxiessen: aduzir — they should bring (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., strong stem; aduxiessen a ssus fijas 'that they bring his daughters'; = trajesen; modern aducir means 'adduce')
ssus: su — their (spelling with initial double s; ssus fijas 'his daughters'; = sus)
gormaz: Gormaz — the castle of Gormaz on the Duero near San Esteban (un castiello tan fuort 'a castle so strong'; = Gormaz)
í: í — there (adverb, Latin ibi; í albergaron 'there they lodged'; = allí; survives in the 'y' of hay)
proes: pro — worthy, valiant (pl.; Pidal's pro[e]s; a guisa de muy proes 'in the manner of very worthy men'; sense from context; = prohombres, de pro)
presentan: presentar — they present, offer (present 3rd pl.; presentan a Minaya grant enffurçión 'they present Minaya with great gifts of provisions'; = presentan)
gradió: gradir — he thanked (preterite 3rd sg.; mucho gelo gradió 'he thanked them much for it'; = agradeció)
coñosçedores: coñosçedor — grateful, one who acknowledges a favour (masc. pl.; que sodes coñosçedores 'for you are grateful'; sense from context; = agradecidos; modern conocedor 'knower')
ffago: fazer — I do (present 1st sg., ff- spelling; assí lo ffago yo 'so do I'; = hago)
estó: estar — I am (present 1st sg.; aquí estó 'here I am'; = estoy)
çielos: çielo — heaven (masc. pl.; Dios de los çielos 'God of the heavens'; = cielos)
gradeçen: gradeçer — they thank (present 3rd pl.; todos gelo gradeçen 'all thank him for it'; = agradecen)
gradimos: gradir — we thank (present 1st pl.; vos lo gradimos 'we thank you for it'; = agradecemos)
viéssemos: veer — we should see (imperfect subjunctive 1st pl.; commo si viéssemos al Criador 'as if we were seeing the Creator'; = viésemos)
gradid: gradir — thank (imperative 2nd pl.; vos a él lo gradid 'you thank him for it'; = agradeced)
rencura: rencura — grievance, sorrow, complaint (fem.; toda nuestra rencura 'all our grievance'; = rencor, queja)
sabremos: saber — we shall be able, we shall know how to (future 1st pl., syncopated; sabremos contar 'we shall be able to tell'; = sabremos)

__broaden__.tornós: tornar + se — she turned back (tornó + -s(e): after a stressed vowel -se shrinks to -s) · also tornarse a + inf. 'to set to, begin' (tornós a sonrisar 'he broke into a smile', perhaps 'smiled again'; the Cid the subject) · also he turned (toward) (tornós a essa part 'he turned that way', the Cid the subject) · also tornós — he turned back (the -s from se; Por el rastro tornós Félez Muñoz 'back along the trail Félez Muñoz turned'; masc. subject, not 'she')
__broaden__.entre: entre — between, among; entre X e Y 'X and Y together' · also entre — entrar, may it enter (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; ante que entre la noch 'before night comes on'; = entre)
__broaden__.ganados: ganar — gained, earned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with its object, as with ovo bastidos; avien ganados = habían ganado) · also ganados — gains, spoils (noun, masc. pl.; Pidal 'ganancias': los ganados que fizo 'the gains he made'; = ganancias) · also ganados — as a noun, winnings, spoils (todos los ganados 'all the booty'; Pidal's note: 'ganancias', v. 481) · also ganado — cattle, beasts (masc. noun, pl.; los ganados fieros 'the wild beasts'; noun, not the past participle; = ganados)
__broaden__.vale: valer — it is worth (present 3rd sg.; que más vale de mill marcos 'which is worth more than a thousand marks'; = vale) · also va + le — 'it goes on (…ing) for him' (ir + gerund with enclitic le: Yal creçe la barba e vale allongando 'and it goes on lengthening for him'; = se le va alargando) · also más vale que 'it is better that' (impersonal; más vale que nos los vezcamos 'better that we conquer them') · also valer — he helps, aids (present 3rd sg.; si Dios non nos vale 'if God does not help us'; = vale, here ayuda)
__broaden__.meresca: merecer — may I earn, deserve (of someone) (present subjunctive 1st sg., with -sca; aun vea el ora que vos meresca dos tanto 'may I yet see the hour when I may earn of you twice as much', i.e. repay you twice over; Pidal 'ojalá os lo pueda pagar con creces', literally 'merezca de vos el doble'; = merezca) · also meresca — 3rd sg. subject, 'may he deserve / requite' (sí vos lo meresca ... nuestro padre 'so may our father reward you for it'; sense approximate; = merezca)
__broaden__.cavalgó: cavalgar — he rode (preterite 3rd sg.; = cabalgó) · also cavalgar — he set (them) on horseback (transitive; las cavalgó 'he mounted them'; = las montó)
__broaden__.peso: peso — weight; sin peso 'without weighing' · also peso — it grieved (preterite 3rd sg. pesó, accent unprinted; de cuer peso esto al buen rey 'this grieved the good king at heart'; = pesó)
__broaden__.tomar: tomar — to take (infinitive) · to seize, catch (en su tierra le pudies tomar 'could seize him in his land') · also tomar — to accept (non gelo quiso tomar 'he would not accept it from them'; = aceptar)
__broaden__.verdad: verdad — truth (dezir vos he la verdad 'I shall tell you the truth'; = verdad) · also non será verdad — 'it shall not be so' (Pidal: 'esto no será así'; esto non será verdad) · also por verdad — truly, indeed (í albergaron por verdad una noch 'they truly lodged there one night')
__broaden__.fincan: fincar — they stop, cease (present 3rd pl.; non fincan de andar 'they do not stop riding'; = quedan, closest cesan) · also fincar — they stay, take their stand (fincan sobre so señor 'they take their stand around their lord'; = se quedan, se plantan) · also fincar — they fix, rest (en el[le] fincan los ojos 'they fix their eyes on him'; = clavan, fijan)
__broaden__.tornando: tornar — turning (gerund; la cabeça tornando va 'he goes turning his head'; = tornando) · also tornar — turning to, tending (Valas tornando a ellas 'he went turning to them'; ir + gerund; sense from context, uncertain; = atendiéndolas)
